free_tier.stated: no free inference allowance stated: the docs say to create a free user account and then top up the credit balance; the API key is required for all requests
free_tier.notes: the FAQ describes a free Company Account to explore models but no free inference credits; purchased prepaid credits never expire; payment methods include credit card, bank transfer and SEPA debit

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible key; AKI.IO admin profile for keys and monthly budget caps
chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent only after topping up credit; the scarce link is the paid balance

limits.value: credit balance must be topped up before use; an optional monthly budget cap can be set in the user profile

binding_note: no free tokens are published, so a topped-up balance binds before any rate

identity_cost.detail: a free user account is created at aki.io/signup; no card or phone field is stated on the docs page

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: a free account is created and then the credit balance must be topped up
evidence.quote: create a free user account at [https://aki.io/signup](https://aki.io/signup) and top-up your credit balance.

evidence.proved: a free Company Account is offered to explore models, but pricing is prepaid credit with no free inference allowance
evidence.quote: Create a free Company Account to explore available models and start integrating the API. For additional evaluation credits or assistance with model selection, Trust Levels, and production workloads, contact sales@aki.io.

notes: the word free applies to the account, not to inference; no free token allowance is published.
